summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature in the botocore repo, without committing. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and the `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` class with all eleven members, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint; made the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added public `compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults` at the end of ClientArgsCreator. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins covering every behavioral acceptance criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 60 passed; test_regions, test_client, test_endpoint, test_utils 663 passed. Not verified: black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked only by line length; the one over-79 line (args.py:315) predates this change. FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private lookup methods, falsy results become False, and s3_config is assumed to be a mapping.
